nfts.total-minted.definition: Cumulative NFTs minted on Solana, including compressed NFTs.
nfts.total-minted.note: Reconciled: /developers/nfts showed 110M+ and /possible's hidden KPI 21.9M; 110M+ kept. No public current total was found and no supported provider tracks NFT mints.

nfts.wallets-ever-held.definition: Unique wallets that have ever held an NFT on Solana.
nfts.wallets-ever-held.note: Undated figure; no supported provider or reachable public dashboard publishes it.

nfts.compressed-mint-cost.definition: Per-NFT cost to mint a compressed NFT at scale (tree rent plus fees).
nfts.compressed-mint-cost.note: Depends on tree size and SOL price; no dated public source. Consistent with gaming.cnft-1m-mint-cost (~$110 per million).
